    for i in range(len(perm) - 1, -1, -1):
        if perm[i] < perm[i + 1]:

    # If there is no such index, then the permutation is the last permutation in lexicographic order
    if i == 0:
        return False
    
    # Find the smallest number j from i onwards such that perm[j] > perm[i]
    for j in range(i + 1, len(perm)):
        if perm[j] > perm[i]:

    # Swap the numbers at indices i and j
    perm[i], perm[j] = perm[j], perm[i]
    
    # Reverse the order of the numbers after index i
    perm[i + 1:] = perm[i + 1:][::-1]
    
    return True
